programmes.d: A vampire that once worked for INTRAcom has mutated and is now staging attacks on his former boss's holdings in an effort to protect the Brazilian rain forest...
Rikki comes to stay at Emma’s house and stirs up the family unit. In trying to compete with Rikki, Emma tries to rebel and throws a party. Nate uses Lewis to make a play for Cleo.

Lewis finds an old book on mermaids and tests out a potion recipe on the girls. Cleo tries to get Don and her Mum together by using her powers to grant him a wish. Realising it’s not what he wants, she finally accepts the situation.

Cleo is worried when she sees her dad around with another woman. When she arrives at their house, she turns out to be Charlotte's mother. Meanwhile, Rikki and Emma attempt to save the Sertori's dinner with their powers.
Everyone is shocked when Cleo is fired at the Ice Cream Stand, and even more so when Lewis takes her place! Rikki and Emma strike back at him but end up going too far.
Zane has an argument with a man in a trailer park but little does he know it’s Rikki’s dad. Rikki has to overcome her shame about her background and introduce her dad to Zane.
Emma meets Ash - a handsome horse riding instructor. A horse falls ill and Emma must use her powers to fix it. Lewis accidentally invites both Charlotte and Cleo to an awards dinner.
Zyro defeats Sakyo to advance to the finals of the Neo Battle Bladers Tournament.
Shinobu loses to Kira in the semi-finals of the Neo Battle Bladers Tournament.
Zyro defeats Kira to win the Neo Battle Bladers tournament.
DNA attacks WBBA Bey Parks and Baihu Xiao defeats Kite Unabara.
At the WBBA qualifying tournament, the DNA arrive and stop the tournament from continuing.
Zyro and his friends launch an assault on DNA Headquarters.
Sabrina's band, the Flavor Babes, use a little magic to launch their careers. The much desired fame and riches end up tearing Sabrina, Chloe, Hilda and Zelda apart.
When Pi sees Sabrina's Uncle Zamboni flying through the air he is convinced there are paranormal rumblings in Greendale. He makes it his mission to prove it to the townspeople.
Sabrina is tired of the restrictions that come with being a kid. She casts a spell that catapults into adulthood.
Sabrina ends up in a new docu-series called, That Witch which becomes an overnight sensation! Sabrina soon tires of the demanding schedule and lack of privacy.
When Sabrina hears that her Grandparents are coming for visit she is excited. They have a important announcement to make.
A new girl arrives at school and quickly catches Archie's attention.
When Reggie falls in love with a B-movie queen, he buys a magical potion to bring her out of the film and into Riverdale.

programmes.t: Archie's Weird Mysteries: Beware of the Glob!
programmes.d: When Miss Beazely mistakenly uses water from one of Dilton's experiments for her school lunch pudding mix, the school dessert comes to life.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: To Have and to Hold Back
programmes.d: Kim attempts to derail Don and Samantha's wedding. Lewis receives an opportunity to study in America. Cleo realises she's got to let Lewis live his own life and let him go overseas.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: Mermaid Magic
programmes.d: Will pushes himself too far when Zane challenges him to prove his skills as a free-diver. The girls discover a unique crystal in the rock from the Moon Pool.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: Power Play
programmes.d: Sophie uses Bella's idea for a fundraising concert and presents it as her own to Rikki to gain publicity for the café. Cleo's caught in the crossfire with Kim when Samantha moves in and puts her stamp on the Sertori home.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: The Dark Side
programmes.d: Rikki's frustrated by the water attacks and goes to Mako Island on a full moon to confront the strange force in the Moon Pool. With Cleo and Bella delayed, Will pursues her and discovers she's been affected by the experience.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: A Magnetic Attraction
programmes.d: Cleo's introduced to Ryan, a young geophysicist who's working for Samantha. Rikki doesn't react well to Cleo consulting Ryan about the Mako rock and a fracture begins to appear in the trio.
Marshall and Simon think they've finally found someone who will believe them - a traveling professor of the 'parabelievable.' But should they be believing him?
During Errie's annual Tornado day, Matt Frewer drops in as a wacky meteorologist whom Marshall helps battle Tornado Bob.
Thirteen year old Greg Davis hates books.
Fourteen year old Julia is obsessed with being beautiful.
Aspiring artist Ralph Philips is focused on perfecting his art.

No matter how hard Gus works on a shrinking formula for Potions Class, it comes out wrong. Frustrated, he thinks about cheating and turning in a commercially made one. Meanwhile, in the underground realm of the greedy Scavenger Imps.
Something strange is happening: knives can't cut butter, bramble bushes are becoming soft (even Gus's comic timing is off). When Cassy and Verne are sent into the mortie village to buy bread.
A film about a mean and violent werewolf is shot in Wolverton. Outraged by the poor misrepresentation of werewolves, Scott decides to be a stuntman in order to change the horror film into a comedy.

Scott becomes infatuated with Shayna the She-Wolf, a T.V. personality who he believes to be a real teen wolf, like himself. He and Stiles decide to travel to Hollywood and find her.

The Howards have been selected to be the All-American Family. However, with the press and media watching their every move, the family is concerned their secret will revealed. The family try to make a conscious effort to act as "normal" as possible.
A new family has moved to Wolverton, and they use their mysterious powers to turn the townspeople into zombies. The only people able to withstand their powers are the Howards.
Scott, Stiles, and Boof head downtown to celebrate Scott's winning touchdown, and Grandma gives him a special potion that will keep him from turning into a werewolf for the night.
In an effort to catch both Veronica and Betty's attention, Reggie attempts to steal some of Dilton's physique enhancing solution.
Riverdale's citizens are scared into a state of shock, being found clutching overdue library book notices.

'The Ghost and Mr. Panther': Pinky unknowingly takes a job as a house sitter…at a haunted house! 'Cleopanthra': Pinky wants to make it as an architect in ancient Egypt but must contend with the Royal Architect who is out to destroy his work.

'Pink Encounters': The Panther mistakes an alien spaceship for his pink caddie and inadvertently blasts into space. 'Junkyard Pink Blues': Pinky goes into business as a Tracer of Missing Pets and finds himself up against the Dogfather.

When superhero Captain Rescue bungles in his attempts to help Sonic, he grows tired of his incompetence. Robotnik then uses Captain Rescue to successfully imprison Sonic in an impenetrable force field, and Tails and Captain Rescue must save him.
Scratch suffers a blow to the head and believes that he is his favorite television character, Edgar Eagle. Sonic uses this to his advantage in preventing another of Robotnik's schemes.
M.A.D. agent, Presto Change0, impersonated Inspector Gadget at a secret meeting. Chief Quimby and Penny foil their evil plans.
Inspector Gadget, Penny, and Brain protect the PootTaFoot's treasure from the evil clutches of M.A.D.

Mr. Bean becomes scoutmaster for the day, but his obsession with badge collecting doesn’t win him any friends. Mr. Bean inadvertently causes an accident, which prevents Irma from taking the scout troop to Big Bear’s Scout Camp.
Mr. Bean inadvertently becomes a teacher. Can he control the unruly class? Mr. Bean cannot find anywhere to park other than the space he spots in a school’s car park.

Mr. Bean finds out he is a Lord and visits his Scottish family home. But keeping a castle is a costly business. Mr. Bean is in the library studying his family heritage. Someone brings to his attention Mr. Bean’s resemblance to a certain Lord Bean.

Mr. Bean finally has a showdown with the mysterious Reliant Robin. Who will be the victor? Mr. Bean and his beloved car find themselves in a crash for crash battle with his arch nemesis the Reliant Robin.
Mr. Bean has to get the bride to the church on time...anyway he can! Mr. Bean has got everything ready for Irma’s birthday; card, cake, candles but he just needs to get her some flowers.
Rip has just bought the Hand of Fatima, a legendary good luck totem, from a gypsy, when it's stolen by a young carny who believes its power can save his Family's New Jersey amusement park.
A vacation in Australia starts on the wrong foot when Rip's wallet is stolen, and left at the sight of a stolen Tjuringa Stone, a sacred aboriginal artifact believed to control peoples dreams.
